evidence: ZrO2 films were deposited by the atomic layer deposition (ALD) method using zirconium t-butoxide and oxygen as the Zr precursor and reactant gas, respectively. The Zr precursor was evaporated at 80°C and introduced into the reaction chamber by a bubbler using the argon (Ar) carrier gas at the same flow rate as the oxygen reactant gas. Ar purging gas was introduced for the complete separation of the source and reactant gases.
